message: Experimental - suitable labelled training data required.

UyghurDF preview.verdict: Not used for training/evaluation: its README states it is a listening sample, and 3 bona-fide clips cannot support any detector.

DeepfakeTIMIT audio.verdict: Original, unmanipulated human speech only (README: audio track kept unmodified) - no synthetic class, so unusable for real-vs-synthetic training.

how_to_enable: Provide a labelled real-vs-synthetic speech set (e.g. ASVspoof 2019 LA, WaveFake, In-the-Wild) and run: python scripts/train_models.py --only audio --audio-real DIR --audio-fake DIR
